sections.Profile:
"The Shark," an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Italian manufacturer A.M.I. in 1976, immerses players in an underwater adventure. The game features two flippers, a pop bumper, three slingshots, three standup targets, a nine-bank drop target, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: A.M.I.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Sharks, Wedgehead, Swimming, Original Theme, Scuba Diving, 1970s, Water
